ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms behavior cases, asserted outcomes and the implementation-detail flag are declared; it does not generate tests.
offer: Generate tests from observable behavior and give every case a concrete expected outcome. Assertions against private implementation structure make refactoring needlessly expensive.

minimal.reason: List the behaviors the cases cover. Cases tied to structure break on refactor, so describe observable behavior.

mid.reason: State a concrete expected outcome per case. An assertion without an expected value proves nothing, so write it.

maximal.reason: Set asserting implementation details to false. Asserting private structure makes refactoring costly, so assert outputs.
